WITH signed_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.balance,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount
      ELSE NULL
    END AS signed_amount
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
),
account_level AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM signed_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_with_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    a.frequency,
    al.avg_signed_amount,
    al.avg_balance
  FROM account_level al
  JOIN account a ON al.account_id = a.account_id
),
freq_level AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS freq_avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS freq_avg_balance
  FROM account_with_freq
  GROUP BY frequency
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount
  FROM freq_level
),
filtered_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    f.frequency,
    f.freq_avg_signed_amount,
    f.freq_avg_balance,
    o.mean_signed_amount
  FROM freq_level f
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
  WHERE f.freq_avg_signed_amount > o.mean_signed_amount
)
SELECT 
  AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount) AS avg_of_avg_signed_amounts,
  AVG(freq_avg_balance) AS avg_of_avg_balances,
  AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount - mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM filtered_freq
